chunks: We are surely sufficient to deal with those who scoff at you,

key_terms.کَفَيْنَاکَ: We are sufficient for you / We suffice you

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God says 'We are sufficient for you against the mockers'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of 'Ismah (infallibility), signifying divine preservation of the Prophet from the corrupting influence of his detractors' mockery. It underscores the spiritual sufficiency (Kifayah) granted to the Prophet, relieving him of the burden of personal vengeance and affirming that ultimate justice rests with God. This assurance serves as a model for the faithful, encouraging patience and trust in divine protection during periods of social or political opposition.
